name: FireButton
description: An invented interface kit built around one canvas-drawn toggle, with the showcase page that sells it
intent: Ten canvases on one page, all of them the same control at different sizes and states. It is the only page here that is a component showcase rather than a product pitch, which makes it the one that shows what a single well-drawn control can carry.

source.title: Canvas Fire Button
source.author: Ray Velez
source.changed: New brand, copy and figures, and a retuned palette
